info.title: Factigent Play API
info.description:
# About Factigent Play
Factigent Play manages industrial connections, contextual metadata, tag mappings, data flows, time-series reports, and execution events.

## Integration guidance
- Use the discovery endpoints before creating dependent resources.
- Runtime scope and role headers are gateway-managed; do not invent them in an LLM.
- Examples are illustrative payload shapes. Replace identifiers, endpoints, and credentials with valid values for your environment.
